Cost: 1 holy pool point

Benefit: As a standard action, the paladin can charge lightning into her weapon and swings downward bringing down thunder and lightning onto her foes. The paladin makes a melee attack at her highest base attack bonus and, if successful, she deals normal damage plus an additional 1d6 half lightning half holy damage for every three paladin levels to the target and all enemies adjacent to the target. All enemies except the target in the area of effect must make a Reflex save (DC 10 + half of the paladin's level + her Charisma modifier) to reduce the damage by half.
